title: Mortgage Pre-Approval Validity, Renewal and Refresh Limits
content:
Each Mortgage Pre-Approval level at Larkspur Home Lending carries a validity period, a renewal period, a cap on renewals, a credit report age limit and a document age limit, together with a setting for whether a renewal re-reviews documents. All periods are counted in calendar days.

| Level | Validity from the issued date (calendar days) | Validity granted by a renewal, from the renewal date (calendar days) | Renewals allowed | Credit report age beyond which a renewal needs a new pull (days) | Document age beyond which reviewed documents must be refreshed at renewal (days) | Renewal re-reviews income and asset documents older than the limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | 30 | 30 | 1 | 120 | 0 | No |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | 90 | 60 | 2 | 120 | 0 | No |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | 90 | 60 | 2 | 120 | 120 | Yes |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | 90 | 60 | 2 | 120 | 120 | Yes |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | 60 | 30 | 1 | 90 | 90 | Yes |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | 90 | 60 | 1 | 120 | 120 | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Validity**: the calendar days from the issued date to expiration.
- **Renewal validity**: the calendar days of validity granted by a renewal, counted from the renewal date.
- **Renewals allowed**: the number of renewals the level allows.
- **Credit report age limit**: the age in days of the credit report beyond which a renewal needs a new pull.
- **Document age limit**: the age in days beyond which reviewed documents must be refreshed at renewal. It is 0 where no documents are reviewed, which is the case at the Larkspur Pre-Qualification and the Larkspur Pre-Approval.
- **Document re-review at renewal**: whether a renewal re-reviews income and asset documents older than the limit.

## Comparisons across levels

- The Larkspur Pre-Qualification is valid for 30 days; the Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval for 60 days; every other level for 90 days.
- A renewal grants 60 days at the Pre-Approval, Verified, Underwritten and Lock & Shop levels, and 30 days at the Pre-Qualification and Jumbo Underwritten levels.
- Two renewals are allowed at the Larkspur Pre-Approval, Verified Pre-Approval and Underwritten Pre-Approval; one renewal at the Larkspur Pre-Qualification, Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval and Lock & Shop Pre-Approval.
- The credit report age limit is 120 days at every level except the Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval, where it is 90 days, the same figure as that level's document age limit.
- Document re-review at renewal applies at the Larkspur Verified, Underwritten, Jumbo Underwritten and Lock & Shop Pre-Approvals, and not at the Larkspur Pre-Qualification or Pre-Approval.
